findings.evidence: Canvas width and height are undefined even with attributes; Wistia’s native canvas clearRect rejects those undefined f64 arguments. DropdownColorPicker also errors in HSVSaturationValueCanvas and HSVHueCanvas before its input can render.
vi.spyOn(window, postMessage) fails because the property is absent; direct probe confirms it.
Media playback spy setup fails because play is absent; direct probe confirms the missing method.
Submitted category values become null; a direct form/input probe produces the value under jsdom but null under the fork.

findings.issue: CSS zero-length serialization differs between inline and computed style
findings.evidence: Inline style.left=0 reads back as 0 in the fork while computed style returns 0px. jsdom returns 0px for both; toHaveStyle comparisons fail.

additional_probe_finding.issue: Custom-element construction and connected lifecycle callbacks are absent
additional_probe_finding.evidence: The registered class is instantiated and connected once under jsdom; neither occurs under the fork. The Wistia react-component test fails under both environments at different stages, so it is excluded from the fork-only regression count.
additional_probe_finding.classification: Browser API gap independently confirmed by a minimal probe; the related Wistia test is not a clean baseline.

methodology: A deterministic feature-stratified sample outside all filenames identifiable in earlier completed reports, interrupted-run logs and Vitest cache.
The initial 200 filters matched one additional TSX companion. The manifest includes all 201 actual files, none in the known exclusion inventory.
The same files and test-case inventory ran against jsdom and the fork. Wistia test sources and setup mocks were unchanged; temporary environment configurations selected the adapter.
Both conditions ran concurrently for compatibility discovery; these runs are not performance benchmarks.
All eight failing fork files were repeated under both environments with one worker per condition. Seven files pass under jsdom and fail under the fork in both runs.
CI=1 uses the previously prepared generated GraphQL artifacts and skips Rails regeneration.
limits: Earlier interrupted full sweeps did not retain complete inventories, so files never mentioned in their logs cannot be proven untouched. These files are outside previously verified coverage and all known attempts.
This is a sample, not the full 3,683-file frontend suite.
